in_marathi.name: Iniya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Iniya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Iniya is a Sanskrit name derived from the Tamil language. It is believed to be the name of the Hindu goddess of love, Bhagavathy or Mariamman. Iniya represents the divine mother's love, compassion, and nurturing nature. The name is also associated with prosperity, happiness, and good fortune.
